title: AllSERP: Exhaustive Per-Element Enrichment of the Versatile AdSERP Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2605.04949v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AdSERP is a public corpus of 2,776 search trials with eye gaze, cursor, scroll, pupil and click telemetry recorded on real Google result pages, together with the page screenshots and captured HTML. Its shipped bounding boxes cover only advertisements, which receive about 16 % of main-axis clicks. AllSERP adds a typed area-of-interest (AOI) layer for everything else: screenshot-anchored boxes for organic results, People-Also-Ask, image packs, local packs and other widgets, labelled from the captured HTML. Three typed flavours trade box tightness for coverage, from tight boxes to gap-filled boxes to per-card cells inside the top-ads carousel. The ad partition agrees with the shipped ad rectangles on all 38,250 comparisons, and box fidelity is measured on the full corpus with a DOM-based harness. Under the gap-filled flavour, 95.7 % of final clicks land in a typed main-axis AOI once cursor coordinates are converted into screenshot space

translated_title: AllSERP：对多功能 AdSERP 数据集的穷举式逐元素增强
translated_abstract: AdSERP 是一个公开语料库，包含 2,776 次搜索试验，记录了在真实 Google 结果页面上的眼动注视、光标、滚动、瞳孔和点击遥测数据，同时还包括页面截图和捕获的 HTML。其随附的边界框仅覆盖广告，而广告只获得约 16% 的主轴点击。AllSERP 为其余所有内容添加了一个类型化的兴趣区域（AOI）层：从捕获的 HTML 中标注的、锚定于截图的边界框，涵盖自然搜索结果、People-Also-Ask（大家还在问）、图片包、本地包及其他页面组件。三种类型化风格在边界框的紧凑性与覆盖范围之间进行权衡：从紧凑框到间隙填充框，再到顶部广告轮播中的逐卡片单元格。广告分区在全部 38,250 次比较中与随附的广告矩形完全一致，并且使用基于 DOM 的测试框架在整个语料库上测量了边界框的保真度。在间隙填充风格下，一旦将光标坐标转换为截图空间，95.7% 的最终点击都落在类型化的主轴 AOI 内。
tldr: AllSERP 通过为 AdSERP 数据集添加覆盖自然结果、People-Also-Ask 等非广告元素的类型化兴趣区域标注层，实现了搜索页面的穷举式逐元素增强，使 95.7% 的最终点击可归入类型化主轴 AOI。
en_tdlr: AllSERP exhaustively enriches the AdSERP dataset with a typed area-of-interest layer covering non-ad elements such as organic results and People-Also-Ask, enabling 95.7% of final clicks to be assigned to typed main-axis AOIs.
